Home › About Us About Us Rooted in the Himalayas, Reaching the World World Himachali Organization (WHO) is a non-profit global platform founded with one purpose — to unite every Himachali, whether they live in the narrow valleys of Kinnaur, the bustling streets of Delhi, or the distant shores of America and Europe. We are the keepers of the Deodar. The voice of the mountains. The bridge between Devbhoomi and the world. From Kullu's apple orchards to Chamba's temples, from Dharamshala's monasteries to Kinnaur's hanging valleys — every shade of Himachali identity has a home in WHO. 🏔 Cultural Preservation 🌎 Global Network 📚 Scholarships 🌿 Environmental Care 💪 Youth Leadership 👩 Women Empowerment Join Our Family → देव Devbhoomi — Himachal Pradesh देवभूमि The Land of Gods The Land of Gods Temples & Sacred Sites Home of the Deodar Sacred Cedar Forests Cradle of Nati Himachali Folk Dance Dhaam Sacred Traditional Feast 2025 Founded Our Story How WHO Came to Be A movement born from the heart of Devbhoomi, built by Himachalis for Himachalis. 🎤 The Vision A group of passionate Himachalis from across India recognized the need for a unified global platform that would connect the diaspora and drive meaningful community development back home. 🤝 Foundation (2025) World Himachali Organization was formally established with a clear mission — preserve Himachali culture, empower communities, and connect the global diaspora under one roof. 🌎 Going Global WHO rapidly expanded its reach to 20+ countries, establishing chapters and connecting Himachalis from Singapore to San Francisco, London to Dubai. 🎯 Today & Beyond With 700+ members and growing, WHO continues its mission — advocating for Himachal Pradesh, supporting communities, and celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Devbhoomi. देवभूमि सेवायै Be Part of This Movement Join thousands of Himachalis worldwide who are proud members of WHO. 🤝 Become a Member World Himachali Organization देवभूमि सेवायै Uniting Himachalis worldwide, preserving our mountain heritage, and driving community welfare for Devbhoomi.
